test.create_query: CREATE TABLE extract_common_leading (k LowCardinality(String), s String, m Map(LowCardinality(String), String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = '10G', min_rows_for_wide_part = 1000000000, auto_statistics_types = ''
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO extract_common_leading SELECT 'a', concat(if(number % 1000000 = 7, 'xqzt ', ''), 'lorem ipsum ', toString(number)), mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> 'k' || toString(i), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> toString(cityHash64(number, i)), range(16))) FROM numbers_mt(2000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE extract_common_leading FINAL SETTINGS mutations_sync=1
test.query: SELECT count() FROM extract_common_leading WHERE k = 'a' AND ((hasToken(s, 'xqzt') AND m['k0'] != '') OR (hasToken(s, 'xqzt') AND m['k1'] != '')) SETTINGS optimize_extract_common_expressions = 1
